# Family Meal Plan

Family Meal Plan is an intelligent weekly calendar and automated grocery organizer designed for busy parents to eliminate the daily dinner stress of "What's for dinner?".

## Key Features

- **Decide For Me Magic:** Every morning, if no dinner is scheduled, the app automatically suggests a recipe chosen from the family's past cooked meals and highly rated favorites.
- **Magic Recipe Importer:** Scan handwritten recipe cards via photo import or paste recipe links from any food blog to instantly convert them into clean digital recipes.
- **16 Diet Profiles:** Select built-in profiles including Gluten-Free, Keto, Vegetarian, Vegan, Dairy-Free, Low Carb, Kid-Friendly, and "I'm Broke" (budget-friendly).
- **Allergies & Exclusions:** Exclude specific dislikes or allergens (e.g., peanuts, shellfish) to automatically filter them out of meal suggestions and shopping lists.
- **Smart Shopping List:** Aggregates ingredients from scheduled recipes into a single consolidated grocery list automatically organized by supermarket aisles.
- **Shop Online:** Direct integration with one-click links to purchase list ingredients on Walmart, Amazon Fresh, Instacart, Kroger, and Target.

## Pricing

14-day free trial with **no credit card required** to start. After the trial, users choose a subscription tier that matches the value the app provides to their family. All features are unlocked on all tiers:

- **Weekly Plan:** $5.99/mo (billed monthly)
- **Standard Plan:** $8.99/mo (billed monthly)
- **Premium Plan:** $12.99/mo (billed monthly)
- **All In Plan:** $5.41/mo (billed yearly at $64.99/yr)

## Technical Stack & Architecture

- **Mobile App:** Built using React Native and Expo.
- **Backend:** Database and user settings stored in Supabase.
- **Billing & Subscriptions:** Managed via RevenueCat integration.
